'''Yoshino Aoyama''' (Japanese: '''青山吉能''' ''Aoyama Yoshino'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Aoyama was born on May 15, 1996 and is affiliated with {{wp|81 Produce}}. Aoyama became a voice actor in 2014 and joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Dot]] and her internet persona Nidothing.
